# Pull request template for improvements branch

This PR wires in improvement components for hero, map, team and research sections. It includes UI stubs and CSS; no binary assets were uploaded by this change.

Review checklist:
- [ ] Verify public/ image filenames and capitalization match the references in the components.
- [ ] Check the homepage and research page locally.
- [ ] Decide whether to replace plain <img> with next/image and enable r3f viewer.

Notes:
- The changes are non-destructive and confined to a review branch.
